N001.summary: At the start of the early game, you have a heavy technology investment and a heavy defensive posture, but your production and expansion are light or uncertain. Your army composition is unknown, and you have no confirmed air presence. Maintain your current development path with a focus on economy and technology, while keeping your defensive posture strong. Avoid overcommitting to a specific army composition or expansion until you have more information about the opponent's intentions.
N001.title: Early Game Balanced Development
